'''Telcom''' was the name of an unidentified form of technology which could be accessed in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was identifiable by an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] sign on a post.
